facts.fact: The blog author states that, based on trends he sees, leading DTC brands allocate 15% or more of their media budgets to streaming TV.
facts.quote: leading DTC brands are allocating 15% or more of their media budgets to streaming TV

facts.fact: The author reports that across accounts he worked with, over 50% of top-of-funnel impact is driven by CTV (vendor-affiliated author's claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: of top-of-funnel impact is driven by CTV

facts.fact: The author reports that top-of-funnel drives roughly 25-45% of total spend across the accounts he worked with (author's claim).
The author reports that new customer CAC improves by 20-30% across the accounts he worked with (author's claim).
The author reports that revenue increases by roughly 30-40% versus trajectory across the accounts he worked with (author's claim).
The author states that when TV spend goes up, CAC comes down, usually within a 10-14 day lag (author's observation).
The author states that brands seeing results run streaming TV always-on (not flighted) and optimize it weekly.
The post states that the author's results reflect independent experience and individual results may vary.
facts.quote: This post reflects the author's independent experience; individual results may vary.
